clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau was staying at a small hotel south of Munich when the owner invited him to dinner.

His wife had driven two hours each way to Nuremberg for sausages that are 100% pork - a special trip just for the meal. Kevin ate them to be polite, and felt no real difference afterward.

His real point: pork alone isn't the emergency people make it out to be. He knows people who've eaten it their whole lives and are still healthy at 95.

What he says actually moves the needle is cutting back - better bloodwork, better hormone numbers, more energy, in his own experience.

Would your bloodwork look any different without it?
